name: CIC-DDoS2019: Distributed Denial of Service Attack Dataset
description: CIC-DDoS2019 is a specialized network security dataset developed by the Canadian Institute for Cybersecurity (CIC) containing realistic benign traffic and 12 contemporary Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attack families. Attacks encompass reflection-based protocols (NTP, DNS, LDAP, MSSQL, NetBIOS, SNMP, SSDP, TFTP, CharGen) and exploitation-based protocols (SYN flood, UDP flood, UDP-Lag). Captured in a controlled B-Profile topology over two days (training day and testing day), it provides raw PCAP files and over 50 million flow records with 80 statistical features generated using CICFlowMeter.
